task_title: Full suite hangs when network is cut
task_criteria: npm test with HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:9 exits nonzero well before a 120s timeout with a visible failure report; tests/guard.test.ts still passes in under 60s without proxy vars

items.criterion: npm test with HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:9 exits nonzero well before a 120s timeout with a visible failure report; tests/guard.test.ts still passes in under 60s without proxy vars
items.detail: Run 1: `env HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:9 HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:9 ALL_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:9 timeout 120 npm test` -> EXIT=1, "Duration 4.00s", "Test Files 110 failed (110)", each file FAILs with "Error: NETWORK-UNREACHABLE: a proxy is configured but nothing answered it — the network is cut. - HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY/ALL_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:9 → ECONNREFUSED: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:9 (25ms)" thrown at tests/net-guard.ts:234 via tests/setup-tmpdir.ts:29. Run 2 (re-confirm): EXIT=1, "Test Files 110 failed (110)", Duration 6.99s, 74 NETWORK-UNREACHABLE lines. Both far under 120s. Second half: `env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u ALL_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u all_proxy npx vitest run tests/guard.test.ts` -> EXIT=0, "Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 36 passed (36)", Duration 908ms (real 2.87s). [resolution 0.03; tests/guard.test.ts]

items.criterion: tests/net-guard.test.ts (the new test file) passes on its own and does not leak proxy env into other test files
items.detail: `npx vitest run tests/net-guard.test.ts` -> EXIT=0, "Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 27 passed (27)", Duration 737ms. Combined `npx vitest run tests/guard.test.ts tests/net-guard.test.ts` -> EXIT=0, "Test Files 2 passed (2) / Tests 63 passed (63)" on two consecutive runs (1.31s, 1.79s), so the env mutations in tests/net-guard.test.ts are restored by the afterEach at tests/net-guard.test.ts:52-60.

items.criterion: tests/guard.test.ts passes in under 60s with proxy vars unset (measured, not inferred)
items.detail: `env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u ALL_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u all_proxy npx vitest run tests/guard.test.ts` -> EXIT=0, "Tests 36 passed (36)", Duration 908ms; first run Duration 1.53s / real 2.87s. Both well under the 60s bound.

items.criterion: SPECLANG_SKIP_NET_GUARD=1 escape hatch actually bypasses the preflight
items.detail: `env HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:9 HTTPS_PROXY=... ALL_PROXY=... SPECLANG_SKIP_NET_GUARD=1 npx vitest run tests/guard.test.ts` -> EXIT=0, "Tests 36 passed (36)", Duration 1.31s, no NETWORK-UNREACHABLE. Implemented at tests/net-guard.ts:196 (`if (env[NET_GUARD_SKIP_VAR] === "1") return;`) and advertised in the thrown message at tests/net-guard.ts:239-241.

items.criterion: NO_PROXY exclusion actually bypasses the preflight for the excluded host
items.detail: `env HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:9 HTTPS_PROXY=... ALL_PROXY=... NO_PROXY=127.0.0.1 npx vitest run tests/guard.test.ts` -> EXIT=0, "Tests 36 passed (36)", Duration 2.37s. Implemented at tests/net-guard.ts:216 (`if (isExcludedByNoProxy(endpoint.host, noProxy)) continue;`).

items.criterion: A silently-dropping (blackholed) proxy also fails fast via the probe timeout, not only on ECONNREFUSED
items.detail: `env HTTP_PROXY=http://10.255.255.1:9 HTTPS_PROXY=... ALL_PROXY=... npx vitest run tests/guard.test.ts` -> EXIT=1, "Duration 2.79s", report "NETWORK-UNREACHABLE ... → no answer within 2000ms (2005ms)". The socket.setTimeout budget at tests/net-guard.ts:180-186 bounds the probe, so a dropped SYN cannot wedge the run.

items.criterion: The full suite without proxy vars still runs to completion (the setupFiles preflight introduces no new failures)
items.detail: `env -u HTTP_PROXY ... timeout 300 npm test` at c3b644a7 -> "Test Files 4 failed | 102 passed | 4 skipped (110)", "Tests 6 failed | 1891 passed | 65 skipped (1962)", Duration 55.25s. The 6 failures are pre-existing: at parent 8ac77df4 (which has no net-guard files) the same 3 files fail with the identical 6 tests (tests/cli.test.ts:437, tests/cli/start-dashboard-contract.test.ts, tests/daemon/arch002-background-daemon.test.ts); the 4th, tests/ci/ci005-precommit-hook.test.ts:79, fails only because this worktree has no .git/hooks/pre-commit. No net-guard-related failure.
